rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for passing an iron over clothes to remove creases.

example.english: I iron this shirt before work.
example.traditional: 我返工前會熨呢件恤衫。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 cin4 wui5 tong3 ni1 gin6 seot1 saam1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the metal or chemical element.

example.english: This piece of iron is hard, and a magnet can attract it.
example.traditional: 呢塊鐵好硬，磁石吸得住。
example.jyutping: nei1 faai3 tit3 hou2 ngaang6 ci4 sek6 kap1 dak1 zyu6

rows.note: Use this for the appliance used to press wrinkles out of clothes.

example.english: I used an iron to smooth my shirt this morning.
example.traditional: 我朝早用熨斗整平件恤衫。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 jung6 tong3 dau2 zing2 ping4 gin6 seot1 saam1
